scenes.setting: The Roselle Memorial Exhibition: gold toilets, plagiarized Yeats, Chinese-chess 'inventions' — a tall veiled lady lingers over the children's exhibits — and in the restored study, bookmarks everywhere: one manuscript pile bears a bookmark painted with Roselle in emperor's clothes
scenes.text_anchor: Roselle had once disguised a Card of Blasphemy as a bookmark and placed it inside a certain book!
